usedFor: Teambook is where people join, and StoreHippo receives each one when “New User Joins” runs “Add User”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joins” in Teambook, then “Add User” in StoreHippo
bestTemplate.why: A person who joins Teambook gets a StoreHippo user, so you do not add them twice.

watchOut: “New User Joins” is polling, so “Add User” runs after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
